title: Libre 2 - (xDrip+ + LibreLink patched) vs. (xDrip+ + MiaoMiao2)
symptom: User asks which method gives more accurate results for the FreeStyle Libre 2: LibreLink 2.3 patched app with xDrip+ or MiaoMiao2 with xDrip+. Later commenters report Libre 2 not working with MiaoMiao transmitters (e.g., 'Checksum failed', no data) and ask for instructions to use the patched app.
cause: The thread concludes the MiaoMiao transmitter is unnecessary and less accurate with Libre 2. The MiaoMiao2 approach has a great disadvantage of false 'calibrations' in xDrip+, and MiaoMiao transmitters can fail to work with Libre 2 (Checksum failed / no data). Libre 2 can transmit directly to xDrip+ through a patched LibreLink app.
fix: Use the patched LibreLink app with xDrip+ instead of a MiaoMiao transmitter. Start the sensor with the patched app; no extra transmitter is needed. Guides referenced include LibreLink-xDrip-Patch and AndroidAPS xDrip Libre documentation.
evidence_quote: Nowadays, having used the patched app for months and comparing it with my first results using Libre 2 + MM2, I can strongly assure that **THE PATCHED APP GIVES FAR BETTER RESULTS than the MM2**, having this last one as a great disadvantage the false "calibrations" in xDrip+.
